owner_decisions.decision_channel: direct instruction to the program integrator session
owner_decisions.modification: AuditRun, Job and Attempt are distinct entities. A new AuditRun is created when a top-level audit or re-audit command is accepted for a frozen set of inputs and configurations. A repeat with the same idempotency key and payload returns the existing Run. Changed inputs, an explicit re-audit or a repeat of a terminal Run create a new Run. Retry, resume, restart and worker failover create no new Run: the Job stays the same and a new Attempt is created. A terminal Run is never reopened.
closes: the review sub-question "what creates a new AuditRun", raised because legacy provides no Run evidence

precedence_clarification.decision_channel: direct instruction to the program integrator session, confirmed on the outcome of the independent review
precedence_clarification.raised_by: independent review of the W0-ARC-01 candidate: the approved PD-03 modification left two of its own clauses overlapping without a stated priority
precedence_clarification.ambiguity: A repeat of a Run that is already terminal, carrying the same idempotency key and the same payload, satisfied two clauses of the approved modification at once: "a repeat with the same idempotency key and payload returns the existing Run" and "a repeat of a terminal Run creates a new Run". PD-03 stated no precedence between them, so one and the same request had two admissible outcomes.
overlapping_clauses: PD-03 modification, idempotent-replay clause: a repeat with the same idempotency key and payload returns the existing Run
PD-03 modification, new-Run clause: changed inputs, an explicit re-audit or a repeat of a terminal Run create a new Run
precedence_clarification.rule: Identical idempotency key and payload ALWAYS return the original Run. A repeat of a terminal Run creates a new Run ONLY under a new idempotency key.
precedence_clarification.effect_on_existing_clauses: Neither clause is changed, narrowed or withdrawn; only their intersection is assigned. In the overlap the idempotent-replay clause wins, and the terminal-repeat clause governs every repeat that arrives under a new idempotency key. The terminal Run is never reopened on either branch: the idempotent replay returns it unchanged, and the new-key repeat produces a separate Run beside it.

consuming_families.obligation: the precedence must be stated over the run_lifecycle triggers: the idempotent-replay trigger takes precedence over the terminal-repeat trigger, and the terminal-repeat trigger creates a new Run only under a new idempotency key
consuming_families.observed_state_at_recording: the run_lifecycle triggers carry the two cases without a precedence between them; the ANA lane is correcting this in parallel

consuming_families.obligation: the same precedence must be stated over the AuditRun creation cases
consuming_families.observed_state_at_recording: the creation cases already return the existing run whatever state it is in and mint a new run for a target whose previous run is terminal only under a new idempotency key

precedence_clarification.consuming_family_note: Both observations are of another lane's unfrozen working-tree draft, read for reconciliation only. This lane certifies neither; the obligation is what binds, not the observed state.

downstream_obligations: DOM lane: encode Run/Job/Attempt identity, the Run-creation rule, idempotent Run return and the terminal-Run rule

both consuming families must reflect it: a family that carries only one of the two overlapping clauses, or carries both without the precedence, is not conformant to PD-03

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Portable audit package swallows embedded Excel generation failure and can still produce a ZIP without it
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: Export manifest declares required members; a missing required member yields a typed partial or failed export with a stable error_code, never a silently incomplete download

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Decision carryover wrapper is fail-soft and yields needs_manual_review with no verdict
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: The pending user-visible state is preserved as a declared state of a declared state machine with a recorded failure class and provenance, never as an implicit empty verdict

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Expert-review shadow-v2 mirror failure is fail-soft
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: No dual write exists in the target; the second view is a rebuildable projection and a build failure is a named observable degraded mode with an owner

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Norm and optimization branches record degradation and let an audit complete with warning artifacts
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: Stage terminal semantics belong to the single versioned stage registry of the owning bounded context, with an explicit consumer policy per state; the policy is split into the three owned parts below and no part may resolve a fail-soft branch to a success
fail_soft_policy.split_authority: repository owner, 2026-09-01, recorded together with the U-06 disposition
fail_soft_policy.split_reason: PD-05 moved the four optimization names out of the analysis boundary, which left that half of a single-owner FS-04 without an encoder. The owner split the policy into three parts, each with a named owner, a target contract family and a task
fail_soft_policy.no_silent_success_rule: No part of FS-04 may be implemented as a silent success rule. The rule admits no exception and binds every part below.

parts.scope: norm and core-audit stage terminal semantics inside the nine-stage core audit registry
parts.target_policy: Stage terminal semantics (ok, partial, failed, skipped) are declared in the single versioned core audit stage registry with an explicit consumer policy per state; a degraded norm branch resolves to a declared non-success terminal state

parts.scope: project-optimization stage and result terminal semantics for optimization, optimization_critic, optimization_corrector and optimization_review
parts.owner_role: project-optimization contract owner, neither the ANA nor the DOM lane
parts.target_policy: The project-optimization bounded context declares its own stage and result terminal semantics with an explicit consumer policy per state; a degraded optimization branch resolves to a declared non-success terminal state of that family and never to a success
conditions: U-06-OB-1: the capability is disabled until W5-OPT-01 is accepted, so this part may not be encoded before that task
U-06-OB-2: CP-00 explicitly excludes project-optimization runtime semantics

parts.scope: AuditRun and Job consumption of an optional optimization branch
parts.task_note: the domain contract task that owns the state machines; if it is already accepted when this rule is encoded, the integrator re-points the part at the next domain contract task without changing the rule
parts.target_policy: Failure of an optional optimization branch resolves the consuming AuditRun or Job to an explicit partial and never to a full success; the outcome is a declared transition of the domain state machines, not consumer-side tolerance

consumer_rule.trigger: an optional project-optimization branch does not succeed

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Comparison AI review falls back to a deterministic summary on provider or validation failure
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: Allowed only as a named, marked and observable degraded artifact that states its own provenance; never presented as completed AI synthesis

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Pipeline and job state partly lives in process-local active task handles alongside persisted logs
evidence: [B] AN-02 stale running converted to interrupted at startup
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: Durable job and attempt state is canonical; process memory is never a status source and recovery is a declared transition

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: Silent identity fallback between an identifier with and without a .pdf suffix during project resolution
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: Identity resolution is an explicit typed lookup; an unresolvable identifier is a typed error, never a guessed alternative form

fail_soft_policy.legacy_behavior: User-visible stage states error, partial, skipped and interrupted plus comparison not_started and stale gates exist without one declared vocabulary
fail_soft_policy.target_policy: Each state maps to exactly one declared target state with declared transitions and a declared alias table; aliases are evidence and never parallel sources of truth
